title: Composed majority influence error identity
statement: For every integer $m\ge 0$, the total influence of the composed majority on the sign cube of dimension $2+(2m+1)$, minus $1+\frac12\sqrt{2/\pi}\sqrt{2m+1}$, equals one half of the total influence of majority on the sign cube of dimension $2m+1$, minus $\sqrt{2/\pi}\sqrt{2m+1}$.
